title: Why Nuclear Power Isn't Actually Dying
hook: Nuclear power was supposed to be finished. One country is building it like crazy.
closing: The supposedly dying industry is quietly shaping tomorrow's electricity supply.
question: Would you live near nuclear power?

segments.say: Builders started 10 new nuclear reactors last year, continuing a small but real rebound.
China alone accounts for 50 percent of all nuclear capacity now under construction.
Worldwide, nuclear power under construction equals building 78 large reactors at once.
